text: Artificial intelligence, or AI, is the ability of machines to perform tasks that normally require human intelligence. This includes understanding language, recognizing images, solving problems, and even making decisions. A key part of AI is machine learning, where computers learn from data instead of being programmed with exact rules. Going further, deep learning uses complex networks inspired by the human brain to handle huge amounts of information, which powers things like voice assistants and face recognition. You encounter AI every day, from recommendation systems on streaming platforms to spam filters in your email and navigation apps that suggest faster routes.
